tier1.notes: Fixes settings being lost when a receiver is unplugged mid-save, and -- more importantly -- a receiver that then refused to save anything at all, failing first-time setup with "storage error" until the card was rewritten. Settings are now written durably, and an empty settings file is treated as a new receiver rather than a damaged one. Installs from the app in a few seconds; no card removal.

tier2.notes: Reflash required only if your receiver is older than 0.24.40 -- newer units can take this over the air from the app. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
